title: Docs: add quickstart section to README
body: Adds a 5-line quickstart so new contributors don't have to read the whole readme.
author: HuyTK
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@
+## Quickstart
+1. Clone the repo
+2. Run `make install`
+3. Run `make dev`
+4. Open http://localhost:3000
